implemented: Collapsed Preset actions includes confirmed permanent Delete of one captured active or archived shared preset. Opening and canceling do not mutate the library or project.
Saved-list Delete/Backspace opens the same confirmation. Text/settings handling, Apply Enter/double-click and native one-Undo application remain separate.

Confirmation binds preset name/id/revision/state, project and writer epochs. Only a verified durable acknowledgment revokes its browser shortcut, clears the row and refreshes; the deleted item is never fetched afterward. Unknown outcomes and refresh failures do not replay deletion.
Deletion uses native cooperative locks and bounded durable metadata recovery. Existing clip effects and project Undo/history are unchanged.
